method: CSV is a numeric-only subset of archived authenticated /metrics?requests=all snapshots.
Original request IDs were replaced with per-batch sequence numbers. Request bodies, model outputs, precise per-request timestamps, hardware IDs, machine paths and authentication are omitted.
All retained rows finished with stop; output_tokens equals engine_generated in every row. Per-row sums reconciled with archived server totals.
Weighted decode = successful output tokens / matching native decode seconds. Weighted prefill = prompt_read tokens / matching native prompt seconds.
Reported median uses the per-request decode_tok_s field, which the server rounds to one decimal.
Generated tokens include reasoning tokens when thinking is enabled. In-flight generation is excluded.
The unlocked window includes a recovery acceptance check. Both windows are observations, not a matched-input benchmark.
Input_at_least_65536 uses total prompt length, including prefix reuse; it is not fresh prompt length.
State getter fmla32/imla2/imla4 was 0/0/0 for unlocked, 1/1/1 for stock.
comparison: Same engine and configuration; different tasks, context lengths, cache reuse and draft acceptance. No causal unlock speedup is calculated.
